description.text: The seventh Black & White set and the first after Pokémon Black 2 and White 2, released on 7 November 2012 with 153 cards: 149 and four secret rares, Shiny Golurk, Terrakion and Altaria and a gold Rocky Helmet. It brought in the new forms of those games, Black Kyurem-EX and White Kyurem-EX, Therian Landorus-EX and Resolute Keldeo-EX, and ACE SPEC cards, Trainers so strong that a deck may hold only one, with a tinsel foil. Its theme decks are IceShock and ColdFire.

description.text: The 1st Place League Challenge copy of Delibird: a crosshatch holofoil print stamped with the Pokémon League logo and its placing, the prize for first place. League Challenges were small tournaments that a store running a Pokémon League could hold once a month; each came with a sealed kit of twelve of these cards, three for each place, for the top four players in each age division. Delibird was the League Challenge card of the Froakie and Xerneas League seasons. The crosshatch pattern marks the early League Challenge promos, from the first events in 2013 until BREAKthrough in 2015.
